user_stories.i_want_to: edit data directly in the grid and persist the changes to the database
user_stories.so_that: I can correct inventory, pricing, or approval information without leaving the debug screen

acceptance_criteria.given: the grid is populated with search results and the user has modified one or more cells
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the Update button and confirms the save dialog with OK
acceptance_criteria.then: the system validates that the grid contains changes, performs the database update, displays a success message ‘登録しました。’, and refreshes the grid with the latest data

acceptance_criteria.given: the grid is displayed but no data has been retrieved or no changes have been made to any cell
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the Update button
acceptance_criteria.then: the system blocks the save operation and displays an information message ‘登録（変更）データがありません。’ without attempting a database update

acceptance_criteria.given: the user has modified a row but left one of the composite key columns (year, month, research theme) blank or invalid
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the Update button and confirms
acceptance_criteria.then: the system attempts the save, the database rejects the incomplete row, the save fails, and an error message ‘更新に失敗しました。’ is displayed; all changes are rolled back

acceptance_criteria.given: another user has modified the same row between the time the current user retrieved it and the current user clicks Update
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the Update button and confirms
acceptance_criteria.then: the system detects the optimistic lock conflict (no rows matched the full-column original values), the save fails, and an error message ‘更新に失敗しました。’ is shown; all changes are rolled back

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is currently editing a cell in the grid (cursor is inside the cell) and has not yet moved focus away
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the Update button
acceptance_criteria.then: the system first accepts the pending cell edit (flushes the edit buffer) before proceeding with the save operation

acceptance_criteria.given: the user has just saved changes and no longer needs the screen
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the Close button
acceptance_criteria.then: the debug window closes and returns focus to the parent window; any uncommitted changes are automatically rolled back

user_stories.technical_notes: Legacy artifacts: w_debug_devtana_mei, dw_debug_devtana_mei, ancestor w_fa_ances_infree. Update is triggered by cb_update.clicked, which chains fw_ck_dwchange(2) (calls AcceptText() and validates that modifications/inserts/deletes exist), u_nullchek (finds required fields – no-op here because dw_debug_devtana_mei has no edit.required columns), u_updtchek (empty hook), confirmation MessageBox, then u_update → dw_data::u_update → This.Update(). Commit uses f_commit(FATRA); rollback on failure uses f_rollback(FATRA). The DataWindow’s updatewhere=1 with all 17 columns marked updatewhereclause=yes creates a full-row optimistic lock. The ancestor key event dispatches Enter presses on buttons, including cb_update.
user_stories.migration_hint: Implement a PUT /api/v1/debug/shelf-labels endpoint that accepts a batch of modified rows with origin/value snapshots for full-column optimistic locking. Perform server-side validation that composite key fields are non-null (legacy relies solely on database constraint). Use a Spring @Transactional service method to replicate the explicit commit/rollback of FATRA. The confirmation dialog and AcceptText behaviour belong in the React component’s state management. The Close button can be a simple navigation action that discards local edits (modern rollback equivalent).

non_functional_requirements.requirement: All database updates within this operation must execute within an atomic database transaction with full rollback on any step failure.

results.module_business_description: Facilitates interactive debugging of inventory operations including stock movements, storage, and product master data. Supports developers and testers in validating business logic and data integrity.

features.title: Shipment Schedule Sequence Search, Update, and Maintenance
features.description: Enables operators to search, insert, update, and delete shipment schedule sequence records via an editable DataWindow grid, with screen capture utilities and transaction management.

functions.label: Search shipment schedule sequences by schedule number (Search)
functions.description: The user enters an optional Schedule No and initiates a search. The system retrieves matching rows from M_AZUHARAKAN and displays them in the grid.

functions.label: Clear search criteria and grid results (Clear)
functions.description: The user clears any entered search criteria and resets the result grid to a blank state. This prepares the window for a fresh search or new data entry.

functions.label: Insert a new shipment schedule row (Row Insert)
functions.description: The user adds a blank row to the editable grid to enter a new shipment schedule sequence. The row is held in the local buffer until the update is committed.

functions.label: Delete the selected shipment schedule row (Row Delete)
functions.description: The user removes the currently selected row from the grid's local buffer. The deletion is pending until the user commits the changes to the database.

functions.label: Save all shipment schedule changes to database (Update)
functions.description: The user saves all pending insertions, updates, and deletions made in the grid to the database. The system performs validation and confirmation before writing the changes permanently.

functions.label: Capture the current window screen for documentation (F12/Ctrl+F12)
functions.description: The user triggers a screen capture of the current window using function key shortcuts. This provides a quick way to document the on-screen data for support or auditing purposes.

functions.label: Close the shipment schedule window and discard changes (Close)
functions.description: The user closes the maintenance window. Any uncommitted changes to shipment schedule sequences are rolled back, ensuring data integrity.

functions.label: Execute the focused button action with Enter key (Enter Key)
functions.description: The user presses the Enter key to trigger the action of the currently highlighted button. This provides a keyboard shortcut for efficient navigation without using the mouse.

business_context.current_state: A PowerBuilder MDI child window (w_debug_devhasoseq) where operators search, insert, update, and delete shipment schedule sequences via an editable DataWindow (dw_1) with command buttons for all operations, including screen capture utilities.
business_context.target_state: A React shipment schedule sequence management page (<ShipmentScheduleMaintenance />) backed by REST microservice exposing GET /api/v1/shipment-schedules, POST /api/v1/shipment-schedules, PUT /api/v1/shipment-schedules/{id}, DELETE /api/v1/shipment-schedules/{id}, with server-side validation and optimistic UI updates.

user_stories.title: Search and View Shipment Schedule Sequence
user_stories.i_want_to: enter a calendar year and retrieve the current shipment sequence number
user_stories.so_that: I can verify the current sequence counter before deciding whether to adjust it

acceptance_criteria.given: the shipment schedule sequence maintenance screen is open
acceptance_criteria.when: the user enters a valid calendar year (e.g., 2024) and clicks the Search button
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays the existing sequence number in the read-only current sequence field and enables the Update button

acceptance_criteria.given: the calendar year input is blank or contains the placeholder '0000'
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the Search button
acceptance_criteria.then: the system shows an information message '西暦を入力してください。' and does not perform a retrieve

acceptance_criteria.given: the entered calendar year has no existing record in the database
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the Search button
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays an information message '該当ﾃﾞｰﾀが存在しません。', clears the sequence fields, prepares a new year context, and enables the Update button to allow creation of a new record

user_stories.technical_notes: Legacy artifact: w_debug_devhasoseq, dw_debug_devhososeq. Search button cb_retrieve (検索) with clicked event that validates the year field, calls dw_data.Retrieve(p_adyy) against parameterized DataWindow, and handles the zero-row case with insertrow+SetItem. Year validation logic inline in cb_retrieve::clicked. Uses headless DataWindow (dw_data).
user_stories.migration_hint: GET /api/v1/shipment-schedules/{calendarYear} to retrieve current sequence number. React component ShipmentSequenceLookup with year input (EditMask) and display fields for current/new sequence, and a Search button.

user_stories.title: Update Shipment Schedule Sequence Number
user_stories.i_want_to: enter a new sequence number and save it to the database for the selected year
user_stories.so_that: I can correct or reset the shipment sequence counter to maintain unique shipment request numbers

acceptance_criteria.given: a calendar year has been retrieved and the Update button is enabled
acceptance_criteria.when: the user enters a valid new sequence number, clicks the Update button, and confirms the operation in the confirmation dialog
acceptance_criteria.then: the system persists the new sequence number, commits the transaction, displays a success message '更新に成功しました。', clears all input fields, and disables the Update button

acceptance_criteria.given: the new sequence number input field is empty
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the Update button
acceptance_criteria.then: the system shows an information message 'SEQを入力してください。' and does not proceed to save

acceptance_criteria.given: a valid new sequence number has been entered
acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the Update button and the database update fails (e.g., due to a connection error)
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rolls back the transaction and displays an error message indicating the update failure

acceptance_criteria.given: the confirmation dialog is displayed after a valid sequence number is entered
acceptance_criteria.when: the user chooses Cancel in the confirmation dialog
acceptance_criteria.then: the system does not save any changes, leaves all fields unchanged, and keeps the Update button enabled

user_stories.technical_notes: Legacy artifact: w_debug_devhasoseq, Update button cb_update (更新) with clicked event that fully overrides ancestor pipeline. Performs Year and SEQ validation, converts em_seq_to.Text to Long, calls dw_data.SetItem(1,'seq',ll_seq) (hardcoded row 1), and dw_data.update(). Manual f_commit(FATRA) on success or f_rollback(FATRA) on failure. Contains a literal defect: failure MessageBox references wrong table name 'TABEL:M_ZAILOTEDA' instead of 'M_DEVHASO_SEQ'.
user_stories.migration_hint: PUT /api/v1/shipment-schedules/{calendarYear} with body { newSequenceNumber } = Long. React component ShipmentSequenceEditor with single-field input and a confirmation modal. Implement atomic transaction with rollback on failure; correct the error message to reference the actual table.

non_functional_requirements.requirement: All sequence number updates must execute within an atomic database transaction with full rollback on any step failure to ensure the counter remains consistent.
